market.summary: The weak open the morning feared did not last: Nifty rose 1.14% to 25,514 and Sensex 1.21% to 83,022, led by autos, consumer durables, FMCG and banks (Nifty Bank a record 63,063), while IT fell for a third day on US rate-hike worries. Foreign investors bought a net ₹7,411 Cr, their eighth straight buying day. Consumption-linked names (both hotel holdings) gained; nothing in the day's moves hurt the open trades beyond normal swings.

points.text: Nifty Auto +4.4%, Consumer Durables +3.6%, PSU Bank +2.3%, FMCG +2.1%; Nifty IT -1.1% (TCS, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, HCL Tech among the losers). Softer copper and aluminium prices were cited for autos and consumer goods.
Nifty Bank rose about 1,024 points to a record close of 63,063, with all 12 members up.
NSE provisional flows for 19 Nov: FIIs net bought ₹7,411 Cr, DIIs net sold ₹1,357 Cr (18 Nov: FIIs +₹5,867 Cr).
US cues stay hawkish: Fed minutes showed most officials expect more rate hikes and the dollar index sat near 103.8, close to a 19-month high; Brent was about $92.6.

market.watch: Whether FII buying continues against a hawkish Fed; Nifty support cited near 25,300, resistance near 25,800.

GROWW.summary: No new filing or deal today. Groww slipped 1.2% to ₹220.89 on a strong market day, closing only ₹0.87 above its 10 EMA (₹220.02); the engine flags the previous session's fall on 2x volume and rates hands WEAK (2 of 6). The trade is +1.67R with the stop at cost, so the gain is protected, but the stock is lagging the financials rally.

points.text: Close ₹220.89 vs 10 EMA ₹220.02 and 20 EMA ₹213.04; peak close since entry ₹227.53; +1R was ₹212.85.
The 17 Nov ₹1,905 Cr block at ₹219 (Ribbit Capital selling) went to funds including BlackRock and Kotak MF; no further block or bulk deal has been reported since.
Nifty Bank closed at a record on 19 Nov while Groww fell, so the stock is underperforming its sector this week (1-week RS vs Nifty Financial Services about -0.1 pp).

GROWW.watch: A close below ₹220.02 (10 EMA, near the ₹219 block price) sells half; below ₹213.04 (20 EMA) the rest.

1-week return +4.4% vs about 0% for Nifty India Consumption (RS +4.45 pp).

INDHOTEL.watch: Sell half on a close below ₹878.18 (10 EMA), the rest below ₹852.86 (20 EMA).
